description: Metadata for custom changes to Backstage scaffolder plugins

changes.title: TaskSteps Accordion Wrapper
changes.description: Wrap MuiStepper in Material-UI Accordion component to provide collapsible task steps UI
changes.author: eliot-pitman-bah
changes.buisnessValue: Improves UX by making task steps collapsible
changes.notes: Changes to TaskSteps may affect stepper behavior. Test accordion state management carefully on upgrades.
testCases: Task steps display properly in expanded state

changes.title: FormContextProvider - New Feature
changes.description: Add React Context for managing scaffolder form data across components. Enables cross-component form state sharing.
changes.author: wbaileydevva
changes.businessValue: Core functionality for form state management - used by custom Stepper
changes.notes: This is a new addition not present in upstream. Safe to carry forward as custom feature. No conflicts expected.
testCases: Hook throws error when used outside provider

changes.title: Package Namespace Rebranding to @bip-bih
changes.description: Rename plugin packages from @backstage/plugin-scaffolder* to @bip-bih/plugin-scaffolder* throughout codebase
changes.businessValue: Maintains custom namespace consistency across all plugins
changes.notes: This is a global search-and-replace pattern. Will conflict on EVERY file touched by upstream on upgrade. Requires systematic reapplication using automated find-replace.
changes.automationApproach: Use regex find-replace on all files under plugins/scaffolder*
testCases: Package.json registry points to custom location

changes.title: Nexus Registry Publishing Configuration
changes.description: Configure package.json and build artifacts for publishing to internal Nexus registry instead of npm
changes.businessValue: Enables publishing to internal Nexus for consumption by BAH environments
changes.notes: Publishing config in package.json is safe to carry forward. Independent from upstream changes.
testCases: Publishing config is present in package.json

steps: 1. Generate patches from each commit using git format-patch
2. For each upstream version, validate patches with LLM
3. Handle namespace rebranding as automated global replace
